outcome.technical: assets/viewer/viewer.js: added setFigureScale/applyFigureScale. Every figure (graph/deployment/trust via renderGraph, ER via drawEr, sequences via renderSeq) now opens fitted to its panel (inline min-width 0, width 100%) instead of min-width max(980, w*0.6|0.7|0.82); a Fit / 100% button pair (.fig-scale, existing .btn class, aria-pressed, data-scale) is inserted once per figure, and 100% sets min-width to the natural viewBox width so the panel scrolls. The inline min-width also overrides the CSS 980/760 floors, so no viewer.css change was needed. tests/visual/screenshots.py: check_figures runs per tab/theme/size/mode and reports an error if the figure overflows or its svg passes the panel's right edge, if the drawing fills under 60% of its viewBox, if the Fit/100% control is missing or Fit is not pressed by default, or if 100% is narrower than Fit. Red before fix, then .venv/bin/python tests/visual/screenshots.py: PASS vs1, 52 screenshots, 0 errors; node --test: 72 pass, 0 fail. I looked at PNGs: graph/sequences narrow show whole drawing (all lifelines, small text, 100% available), trust desktop dark fully visible. Caveat: at 400 px Fit text is tiny; readable via 100%. Dependants: tests/visual/README.md still correct but does not mention the new layout checks (not in my files, not edited); viewer.css, render.mjs, tests/viewer.test.mjs and docs/design.md are unaffected (no class/ids renamed, tests pass, inline min-width overrides the CSS floors; design.md untouched, may want a line on the scale control).
outcome.descriptive: Viewer figures now fit the panel width by default with a Fit/100% control, and the screenshot script fails on clipped, blank or control-less figures.
